title: Excluding Files from Coverage
description: A .coveragerc that omits the REPL, the tests, and setup.py, so coverage only grades the core interpreter modules.

steps.description: This is `.coveragerc`, a coverage configuration file. The page says to add it if you have files that should not count toward coverage, such as the REPL, a file-runner, or generated parser tables.
`[run]` starts the settings for running coverage, and `omit =` begins the list of paths to leave out.
The list holds `repl.py`, everything under `tests/`, and `setup.py`. The page says coverage reports will then only grade the core interpreter modules.
